method: Keep all fitted weights fixed. Threshold is no higher than original and is at the midpoint below the lowest positive score across connected-fold OOF and refitted development predictions. Requires 100% development concern coverage; unchanged 99% recall and 5% false-review release gates still apply to both groups.
rationale: Existing calibration miss counts motivated a more conservative development-only operating point. No calibration scores or labels enter the threshold calculation; this audit is reused regression evidence, not independent validation.
selection: Four predeclared parent/language combinations; no further threshold search in this experiment.
